messages:
maya: Hey all — uploaded a new prototype for Prompt Sets > Eval Runs. Major change: two-pane row (left = metadata, right = diff preview) and move approval affordance out of the floating FAB into a persistent toolbar action. Need accessibility and microcopy review before I freeze for dev. figma: https://figma.com/file/xxx
sam: Nice direction. Two-pane feels more scannable, but how does it behave on tablet (1024px)? Want to avoid hiding metadata below the fold.
maya: At <=1100px it stacks (meta on top, preview below). I added a responsive rule.
jorge: Keep status badges pinned so they never reflow offscreen. Users scan those first.
rita: Accessibility: expose each row as a single listitem (role=list + role=listitem) not two separate widgets. Link aria-labelledby to the run title.
ux-bot: a11y note: announce when diff preview opens: "Diff preview opened for run <id>" via aria-live polite. Ensure expand/collapse works with Enter/Space.
sam: Microcopy: toolbar label should read "Approve selected" (avoid "bulk"). Tooltip: "Approve selected eval runs and lock scorecards".
maya: Also changing confirm modal copy. Current "Are you sure?" -> Proposed: "Approve 3 runs? This will mark results as approved and prevent edits unless unapproved by a project admin." Add link to docs.
jorge: Modal should state who can unapprove. If it's project admins only, call that out explicitly with a docs link.
rita: Modal needs aria-describedby pointing at the detail paragraph so screen readers read the consequences.
sam: Visual nit: increase selection checkbox from 18px -> 24px for touch/hit target. Add clear indeterminate state.
maya: Will update. UX question: show quality/confidence? I currently hide scores in expanded diff. Maybe a small score chip (0-100) in the row.
jorge: Score chip makes sense. Ensure color contrast meets AA; include hidden text "Quality score: 86" for SRs.
ux-bot: contrast check: small green chips need bold 14px text to pass. Consider HC icon alternative for tiny chips.
sam: Keyboard nav: j/k to move rows only when focus is on list container; if focus moves into diff textarea, shortcuts should not hijack.
rita: Also run RTL test for two-pane flip; ensure focus order still logical.
maya: Other a11y: increase chevron hit target to 40px and add aria-label "Show diffs". Add visible high-contrast focus ring on approve button: `button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,120,215,0.35); outline: none; }`.
sam: Toast/undo flow: after approval show toast "Approved 5 runs. [Undo] [Open change log]" with 10s undo window. "Open change log" clearer than "View changes".
jorge: Also add an ellipsis action in toast to view affected run ids.
maya: Plan: pinned badges, 24px checkboxes, score chip, revised modal copy + admin unapprove note + docs link, aria-live announcements, larger chevrons, scoped keyboard shortcuts, toast with undo and change-log link.
rita: I'll do a keyboard-only pass and paste the steps + screenreader narration examples here for handoff. Please include those in the a11y checklist for eng.
maya: Thanks! Will update prototype and post new figma by EOD. :thumbsup:
